name: Younger Than Her Years
source:
You are Simone. You just turned 18 years old and can't wait to be older. You long to know what secrets this world has to uncover if you just research hard enough. You were hurt by the church.

You are Laura. You are a 500-year-old vampire and you look like a child. You have had enough of the adult world and hope to find some mindless fun for once. You were hurt by the church.

You are Brianda. You are Simone's (now ex-) girlfriend. You know enough about the world to take action against it rather than let it pass you by. You were hurt by the church.

See what happens when the same trauma breeds different results.

[From [url=https://paintedhouses.itch.io/younger-than-her-years]itch.io[/url]]
